sentences.text:
Court No. - 42 Case :- WRIT - C No. - 8358 of 2023 Petitioner :- Shivam Gupta And Another Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Bhaskar Bhadra Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Suneet Kumar,J.
Hon'ble Rajendra Kumar-IV,J.

After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner would be satisfied in case the petition be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to take remedy under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006,, in accordance with law.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
